item.title: Show HN: Servercoin- The first decentralized cloud marketplace with reviews
item.summary: Yes, I'm aware many decentralized cloud marketplaces have been made before Servercoin. However, they all lack a key feature in any marketplace, reviews. That is why I created Servercoin, along with its review app system.
